tags: [houseplants, propagation]

The golden pothos on top of the dresser had trailed to the floor, 2.3 m on the longest stem, so on 2 May 2024 I took nine cuttings, each with two leaves and a node, and stood them in old jam jars of rainwater on the kitchen windowsill. Changed the water every Saturday. First roots on day 8, all nine rooted by day 19 (21 May). Potted up four into 9 cm pots of multipurpose and perlite on 4 June once the roots were 5 cm long; Alfie took three for his flat in Plymouth and two went to the plant swap at Lustleigh village hall on 15 June. The ones left in water longest sulked when potted, so roots at 3 to 5 cm is the moment. Care notes for the parent plant are in [[绿萝养护]], and the watering in [[Watering schedule]].
